shortDescription: Upper-locking and bearing-assembly hydraulic nuts for controlled axial loading, retention, installation, and removal.
longDescription: ToughTorq hydraulic nuts use hydraulic pressure to apply controlled axial force for large-fastener loading and bearing installation or removal. The range includes upper-locking hydraulic nuts for mechanically retained load and ultra-high-pressure bearing-assembly nuts for shafts, tapered seats, bushings, flywheels, propellers, and rotating-equipment maintenance.
features: Controlled axial loading through hydraulic pressure
Upper-locking models mechanically retain load after pressurization
Bearing-assembly models simplify installation and removal on tapered shafts and bushings
Wide metric and trapezoidal thread coverage
Designed for heavy industrial maintenance and assembly

operatingRequirements.label: Hydraulic System
operatingRequirements.value: Match pump, hose, couplers, pressure rating, thread, and application geometry to the selected hydraulic nut

compatibility: Thread form and size must match the bolt, shaft, or sleeve.
Hydraulic power components must be rated for the operating pressure of the selected nut.
Application geometry, available clearance, and retained-load requirements determine whether an upper-locking or bearing-assembly hydraulic nut is appropriate.
sourceReference: 2026 ToughTorq catalog pages 40–41
ToughTorq/Kashon Upper Locking Type Hydraulic Nut and Hydraulic Nut for Bearing Assembling and Disassembling tables
